attributes.title: 2027 TNA Annual Conference: Navigating New Horizons in Nursing
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Texas Nurses Association Annual Conference, "Navigating New Horizons in Nursing," takes place June 9 to 11, 2027, at the Omni Corpus Christi. A special track is planned for prelicensure nursing students.

Registration is open through TNA's education portal, and a discounted room block is available at the Omni. TNA's registration page lists the main program on June 10 and 11 with 10.25 contact hours from TNA's ANCC-accredited provider unit. Early-bird registration is $425 for members and $575 for nonmembers until February 28, 2027, against a full price of $675; LVNs pay $285, and prelicensure students pay $125 for the first day or $285 for both days.
